name: careerpulse
description: Career roadmaps for 20 trending tech fields, with live jobs and salary data for Bangladesh, remote and global markets.

paragraphs: Research-based career roadmaps for 20 trending tech fields, with a focus on Bangladesh, remote work and global markets.
Live demo · Features · Tech stack · Getting started

CareerPulse helps students and career-switchers pick a tech career and start learning the same day. Each of the 20 fields comes with a plain-English explanation, job roles, a beginner → advanced skill list, the languages and tools employers ask for, a 30/60/90-day roadmap, free resources, portfolio projects, interview questions, resume bullets, and salary and demand data for Bangladesh, remote work and global markets. Every salary figure links to its source.
features: 20 researched career fields. AI agents, ML, data science, data engineering, cybersecurity, cloud, DevOps/SRE,
full-stack web, mobile, UI/UX, product management, prompt/context engineering, AI governance, fintech, embedded/IoT, green tech, robotics, AR/VR, blockchain and quantum computing.
